<div class="sheet-page" id="H9-A">

## Page 1 | H9-A: draft decision note

**To:** Director, programme investment  
**Subject:** GreenWaste expansion decision  
**Status:** Draft for review; fictional training case

Read the recommendation, its qualifications and Table T9 before recording your own advice. This note is separate from the report you will read on Day 4.

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(d9_note_html())
```

### Table T9 | Annual saving per business at 12 months

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(d9_results_table())
```

**Units:** AED per business per year. Positive numbers mean reduced waste cost. Interval endpoints are sorted on that saving scale. **Decision rule:** minimum annual saving of **1,000 AED**.

The pilot is a separate district sample. The city difference between the two changes, the score cut-off and matching use the same city records; they make different comparisons. H9-B on page 2 describes them. Source IDs point to the analyst cards, supplied during the clinic.

<p class="caption">Paragraph IDs N1-N3; table ID T9. Source: GreenWaste data. Each interval is the 95% interval for that method. Do not substitute this draft for a verified national appraisal.</p>

</div>

<div class="sheet-page" id="H9-B">

## Page 2 | H9-B: what was compared?

The four estimates concern annual waste cost at 12 months. A shared outcome and common sign do not make populations, comparisons or causal requirements interchangeable.

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(d9_table(d9_map))
```

The city file has **10,000 businesses**, including **4,794 participants**. RDD uses a local subset; matching selects and may reuse city controls. City results are not independent replications of one national effect. The lottery pilot is a separate **400-business** sample.

### Five families for useful questions

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<ol>',paste(sprintf('<li>%s</li>',read_questions),collapse=''),'</ol>'))
```

Choose the questions that could change your decision. Specify the result or document you need, then say what you would do with the answer. A method name or a reassurance that the work is robust is not the requested evidence.

<p class="caption">H9-B is a comparison map, not an assurance that these requirements hold. E1-E8 contain the supplied evidence and its limits. No fieldwork, prior-trend or score-manipulation records should be invented.</p>

</div>

## Page 7 | Copilot Snapshot, Stage 2

**7 minutes:** use the improved prompt in Copilot if available and approved. Answer its clarifying questions briefly, then verify the output. Use only this fictional case, not workplace or personal data.

### A decision-focused prompt

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<p class="prompt">',d9_prompt,'</p>'))
```

**Source bundle:** worksheet H9-A/H9-B, pages 1-2, plus analyst evidence bank E1-E8, pages 1-4, now supplied after the clinic. The draft note is a claim to review; the cards identify supplied evidence and unavailable checks.

If access or response time fails, use the prepared paper alternative on page 8. The task and seven-minute limit stay the same. No second chat is required.

## Page 8 | Prepared paper alternative

**Hold until Stage 1 is finished.** Use for Stage 2 when Copilot is unavailable, slow or not approved. This response was written for the exercise. It is not a real AI answer.

### Possible clarifying questions

What population and delivery conditions does expansion cover? What risk of failing to reach the 1,000 AED saving rule is acceptable? Is the main concern whether GreenWaste caused the change, national reach, data quality or total spending?
